programs.name: Gymnastics: Tumbling - Beginner
programs.description: Flexibility, strength, coordination and balance, gymnastics has it all. With a focus on basic floor and acrobatic movements and safe landing techniques, you will learn and practice basic skills such as skipping, rolls, jumps and turns on the floor.

programs.name: Gymnastics: Tumbling - Intermediate
programs.description: Flexibility, strength, coordination and balance, gymnastics has it all. With a focus on improving strength and form, you will learn and practice skills such as front and back rolls, handstands, cartwheels, bridges, leaps, jumps and turns on a variety of apparatuses. Prerequisite: Gymnastics (Beginner).

programs.name: Hockey Skills
programs.description: Come and enjoy Canada’s national pastime—hockey! This activity introduces new hockey players to basic hockey skills and the rules of the game to prepare you for a house league or recreational play. Learn puck and stick handling, passing and shooting, as well as game strategy through a combination of lessons, drills and play.Prerequisite: Successful completion of Learn to Skate - Beginner or be able to skate one length of the ice surface.Equipment: Skaters must bring (wear) a CSA-approved hockey helmet with a full  visor or cage, a hockey stick, hockey skates, hockey gloves and a neck guard.
programs.location: Gord and Irene Risk Cmty Rec Centre

programs.name: Intermediate First Aid with CPR-C & AED - Recert
programs.description: This course is offered in collaboration with the Lifesaving Society (in accordance with CSA Z1210:24). This recertification course provides a review of first aid and CPR skills. Practical skills are assessed through scenarios and knowledge will be tested through a written evaluation.Prerequisite: Current Intermediate First Aid (CSA Z1210:24).For information about attendance, withdrawals and refunds for courses offered with the Lifesaving Society, visit www.toronto.ca/recskills.

programs.name: Acrylic Landscapes
programs.description:
Discover the beauty of landscape painting in this hands-on acrylic workshop designed for beginners. Learn how to transform a blank canvas into a vibrant natural scene using colour, texture, layering, and composition techniques. Materials list will be provided.

This course is also offered as a four-week intensive.

programs.name: Acrylic Landscapes Intensive
programs.description: Discover the beauty of landscape painting in this hands-on acrylic workshop designed for beginners. This course is a four-week intensive and is also offered as a full eight-week course.

programs.name: Gymnastics: Tumbling - Beginner
programs.description: Flexibility, strength, coordination and balance, gymnastics has it all. With a focus on basic floor and acrobatic movements and safe landing techniques, you will learn and practice basic skills such as skipping, rolls, jumps and turns on the floor.

programs.name: Gymnastics: Tumbling - Intermediate
programs.description: Flexibility, strength, coordination and balance, gymnastics has it all. With a focus on improving strength and form, you will learn and practice skills such as front and back rolls, handstands, cartwheels, bridges, leaps, jumps and turns on a variety of apparatuses. Prerequisite: Gymnastics (Beginner).

programs.name: Hockey Skills
programs.description: Come and enjoy Canada’s national pastime—hockey! This activity introduces new hockey players to basic hockey skills and the rules of the game to prepare you for a house league or recreational play. Learn puck and stick handling, passing and shooting, as well as game strategy through a combination of lessons, drills and play.Prerequisite: Successful completion of Learn to Skate - Beginner or be able to skate one length of the ice surface.Equipment: Skaters must bring (wear) a CSA-approved hockey helmet with a full  visor or cage, a hockey stick, hockey skates, hockey gloves and a neck guard.

programs.name: Intermediate First Aid with CPR-C & AED - Recert
programs.description: This course is offered in collaboration with the Lifesaving Society (in accordance with CSA Z1210:24). This recertification course provides a review of first aid and CPR skills. programs.name: Gymnastics: Tumbling - Beginner
programs.description: Flexibility, strength, coordination and balance, gymnastics has it all. With a focus on basic floor and acrobatic movements and safe landing techniques, you will learn and practice basic skills such as skipping, rolls, jumps and turns on the floor.

programs.name: Gymnastics: Tumbling - Intermediate
programs.description: Flexibility, strength, coordination and balance, gymnastics has it all. With a focus on improving strength and form, you will learn and practice skills such as front and back rolls, handstands, cartwheels, bridges, leaps, jumps and turns on a variety of apparatuses. Prerequisite: Gymnastics (Beginner).

programs.name: Hockey Skills
programs.description: Come and enjoy Canada’s national pastime—hockey! This activity introduces new hockey players to basic hockey skills and the rules of the game to prepare you for a house league or recreational play. Learn puck and stick handling, passing and shooting, as well as game strategy through a combination of lessons, drills and play.Prerequisite: Successful completion of Learn to Skate - Beginner or be able to skate one length of the ice surface.Equipment: Skaters must bring (wear) a CSA-approved hockey helmet with a full  visor or cage, a hockey stick, hockey skates, hockey gloves and a neck guard.
programs.location: Gord and Irene Risk Cmty Rec Centre

programs.name: Intermediate First Aid with CPR-C & AED - Recert
programs.description: This course is offered in collaboration with the Lifesaving Society (in accordance with CSA Z1210:24). This recertification course provides a review of first aid and CPR skills. Practical skills are assessed through scenarios and knowledge will be tested through a written evaluation.Prerequisite: Current Intermediate First Aid (CSA Z1210:24).For information about attendance, withdrawals and refunds for courses offered with the Lifesaving Society, visit www.toronto.ca/recskills.
